newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares sag as Wolford drops to year low.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares sag as Wolford drops to year low.

text.p: Austria's blue-chip ATX index closed with moderate losses on Tuesday, weighed down by sales in certain market heavyweights.
The ATX fell 7.18 points, or 0.56 percent, to 1,283.69 with 15 shares lower and six higher by the close. The ATX managed to crawl off session lows at 1,278.07.
Activity was dominated by traders, with investors sitting on the sidelines.
Traders said that although support at 1,280 held by the close, further assaults on the downside could not be ruled out.
"We might take another look at 1,260," said one, expecting short-term downward pressure.
But another trader sees the ATX "heading for 1,300 points again" as long as Wall Streets fares well.
The index's leading decliner was luxury hosiery and lingerie maker Wolford, which tumbled 4.2 percent to 1,070 schillings to record a new closing low for the year.
"There's a pretty big sell order in Wolford and it doesn't look as if it's over yet," said a trader.
Viscose fibres manufacturer Lenzing led gainers, adding on 1.4 percent to 715.9 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 2.15 points, or 0.45 percent, to 470.96.
The July ATX future lost 4.1 points to 1,285.9 points.
